title: [ISSUE #5392] [RIP-55] Support remoting protocol in rocketmq proxy module

timeline.body:
Close #5392
Close #5486
Close #5485
Close #5406

## What is the purpose of the change

Support remoting protocol in the rocketmq proxy module, including the rocketmq-client which version >= 4.9.5 for 4.9.x branch and version >= 5.0.1 for develop branch.

## Brief changelog

See [wiki](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/wiki/RIP-55-Support-remoting-protocol-in-rocketmq-proxy-module) for more information.

Including three parts.

1. Remoting server implementation and protocol negotiation for both remoting and gRPC protocol.
2. Connection module: Including heartbeat management and synchronization.
3. Message module: Including sending and receiving messages implemented by request to the corresponding broker.

This looks weird, settings are parsed from the channel but grpcClientSettingsManager is an argument to build Channel. 
@xdkxlk Do we have a cleaner way to resolve this circular dependency?

reply.body: The purpose is different. The parseChannelExtendAttribute method of GrpcClientChannel is a tool method to try to convert the attribute to the Settings. And the grpcClientSettingsManager is passed to channel in order to get extendAttribute of this channel in real time.

timeline.body: If there are two proxy instances on one machine, will there be a problem? The same address cannot distinguish different heartbeat data, maybe we need a unique proxyId?
